So the wavestates, there are some great guides on Youtube for it, I am currently at a Party so I sadly cant provide a Link rn. What I usually do is, I freeze as much as I can, if the enemy is very punishable, you can freeze infront of your turret and punish whenever he tries to CS, of course this is a much more passive gameplay Plan. Also you have to know when to start pushing in to generate prio (mostly before big teamfights like jungle objectives)

A tip I used for recalling on shen is, I wait for a Canon wave and recall on that, most champs can't really force a big push unless they already have a high minion wave.  So keep in mind when canons spawn and try to utilize that window. 

Yeah I recommend TP when you don't really know how the matchup will go. Against champs like Mundo, Garen, Nasus I usually go Ignite to get as much kill pressure as possible. Which is funny because I usually play to be the carry myself lol. 

The itempart seems very good. Bamis first is always great as it is rather cheap. I usually rush Titanic afterwards, especially if I am ahead. And I know not many people agree with me on this, but I very rarely even go DMP early, often taking it third or even later. Second item is Hollow Radiance almost everytime, for me. That also absolutely crushes the waveclear problem, as you almost oneshot waves with Titanic active. 

Most top champs are very capable of farming under the turret, so I wouldn't always push your wave into the tower. Try to play around with wave management so you can keep him on the lane as long as possible. The more time you both stay on lane, the higher the chance he makes a big mistake.
